findings.description: No key policy (or aws_kms_key_policy resource) is defined, so the key falls back to the AWS default policy granting full kms:* access to the account root and any IAM principal with sufficiently broad IAM permissions. For a key protecting audit trail data, this is overly permissive and lacks least-privilege controls.

The enable_key_rotation attribute is not set, which defaults to false, so automatic annual rotation of the KMS key material is disabled, weakening cryptographic hygiene for a key protecting sensitive audit trail data.
